title: Figure 10: Close-up of spiderwort stamens and blue stamen hairs
description: Macro color photograph of a blue-violet spiderwort flower showing fine fuzzy blue stamen hairs topped with bright yellow anthers against a dark background. The caption reads "Figure 10 - Close up picture of spiderwort stamens and stamen hairs." The text explains the spiderwort assay looks for stamen-hair color changes from blue to pink as an indicator of mutation, to be examined microscopically in future deployments.
